entity_place_properties.name: entity_place_properties
entity_place_properties.value: type = 'LOC' OR (country IS NULL AND admin1 IS NULL AND geonames_id IS NULL AND geom IS NULL)

item_not_own_duplicate.name: item_not_own_duplicate
item_not_own_duplicate.value: dup_of IS NULL OR dup_of <> item_id

media_dimensions_positive.name: media_dimensions_positive
media_dimensions_positive.value: (width IS NULL OR width > 0) AND (height IS NULL OR height > 0)

engagement_likes_valid.name: engagement_likes_valid
engagement_likes_valid.value: likes IS NULL OR (likes_kind IS NOT NULL AND (likes_kind = 'score' OR likes >= 0))
